snap_down_object: snap a rigid object down onto the nearest support surface in the gravity direction with collision checking
get_obj_from_id: get a ManagedRigidObject or ManagedArticulatedObject instance from its integer object id in the simulator
size_regularized_object_distance: compute the heuristic surface-to-surface distance between two objects regularized by their bounding box sizes
open_close_link: open or close an articulated object link by setting its joint position to the max or min limit
get_obj_receptacle_and_confidence: match a potential object placement point to a candidate Receptacle and return a confidence score
